finance_app

This binary was built without the frontend, so only the API is being served. The endpoints under /api/v1 work normally — try /api/v1/health.

This page is a placeholder that exists so go build succeeds in a bare checkout. To get the real interface, either build the Docker image, which compiles the frontend and embeds it, or run npm run dev in frontend/ and use the Vite dev server on port 5173.
